assay.description: Herbicidal activity against Amaranthus retroflexus at 1.5 kg/hectare administered postemergence of first true leaf measured after 10 days

document.abstract: A series of arylhydrazino-substituted cyanoacrylates 3 and N-aryl pyrazolecarboxylates 6 were synthesized and their bioactivities were evaluated. Though compounds 3 were designed as herbicide, some of them showed fungicidal activity and anti-tumor activity. Some of the compounds 6 exhibited plant growth regulatory activity.
document.authors: Liu Y, Liu S, Li Y, Song H, Wang Q.
document.title: Synthesis and biological evaluation of arylhydrazinocyanoacrylates and N-aryl pyrazolecarboxylates.
